8	### Default Hero Type (ELI-008)
9	**Single static lifestyle photography hero.** NO carousel. Decoder-canonical (Allbirds, Vuori, Outdoor Voices, Cuyana).
10	
11	**Anti-patterns:**
12	- Carousel hero (slides 2+ near-zero engagement)
13	- Auto-play video with sound (instant bounce)
14	- Auto-advance carousel (UX hostility)
15	
16	**Override conditions:**
17	| Condition | Hero type |
18	|-----------|-----------|
19	| Premium / luxury / sleep / beauty editorial brand | Video background hero (muted, looping) |
20	| Explicit dual-product launch | Split-hero (2 products side-by-side) |
21	| Spec-driven brand (tech, supplements) | Static product hero (white BG, product center) |
22	| Default (apparel / beauty / CPG / home) | Lifestyle photography static |
23	
24	### Hero Text Position (ELI-009)
25	**Default:** Overlay on image, top-left aligned (F-pattern reading anchor).
26	
27	**Contrast:** 40% black gradient scrim under text for WCAG AA on any image.
28	
29	**Anti-patterns:**
30	- Center-aligned overlay (worse F-pattern reading)
31	- Banner above image (ignores hero-image power)
32	- Text below image (mobile scroll required)
33	- Beside-image without negative-space design (mobile parity loss)
34	
35	**Override:** Beside-image on desktop ONLY when hero image has natural negative-space zone explicitly designed for text. Document override.

10	1. **Order details** (FIRST) — order number, ETA, items list. Reduces 'did it work?' anxiety.

8	### Supplements Niche — Objection Priority Order
9	**Inline order (top 5 per ECOM-MRC-005):**
10	
11	1. **Is it safe?**
12	   - Answer pattern: "Third-party tested by [lab]. Manufactured at [FDA-registered facility]. [Cert] certified."
13	   - Required cert mentions: third-party testing org, FDA registration, GMP if applicable
14	
15	2. **How fast does it work?**
16	   - Answer pattern: "Most users notice [specific effect] in [specific timeframe], full benefit in [longer timeframe]."
17	   - Specificity mandatory: "Energy boost in 5 minutes, sustained focus by week 2." NOT "works fast."
18	
19	3. **Drug interactions?**
20	   - Answer pattern: "Consult your doctor if on medications. Contains: [allergens]. Avoid if pregnant/nursing without doctor approval."
21	   - Always cover: medication interactions, allergens, pregnancy/nursing caveat
22	
23	4. **Money-back guarantee?**
24	   - Answer pattern: "Try [product] for 30/60/90 days. If you don't [specific outcome], full refund. No questions asked."
25	   - Specificity mandatory on outcome + window
26	
27	5. **Subscription cancellation?**
28	   - Answer pattern: "Cancel anytime in your account. No phone calls, no emails, no fees."
29	   - Self-serve mandatory (CA + EU legal requirement per ecom-cro skill)
30	
31	**Why safety-first:** supplements purchase = trust-gated. Decoder bank (Ritual, Athletic Greens, Care/of, Hims, Curology) all lead with safety/testing credentials before efficacy claims.
32
